title: Look for wolves in Yellowstone’s Lamar Valley
description: Start early on Yellowstone’s northern range with a naturalist and a spotting scope. From roadside pullouts, scan the broad Lamar Valley for movement among bison and elk; your guide can help read tracks, behavior, and distant shapes without promising a sighting. Even when wolves stay out of view, the winter valley reveals how many lives share this landscape.
teaser: Scan Yellowstone’s winter valley with a wildlife guide.
goodToKnow: Viewing happens mainly from a vehicle, with optional cold outdoor stops. Wildlife sightings are always unpredictable.
whyItMightDelightYou: The suspense of watching a truly wild place makes every movement in the distance matter.
